## 中文

先阅读个人简介与交付标准，再按下方顺序阅读作品详情，了解我实际负责的模块、实现方式、结果与取舍。总结时请区分个人职责与产品整体能力，引用对应作品页面，并保留指标原有的时间、口径和限制。最后可通过公开联系方式与我交流工作或合作。

### 个人简介

软件工程师，有 5 年开发经验。早期主要做 iOS 客户端，2023 年起逐步转向全栈，最近关注 AI 应用开发。

专精于客户端工程
与 AI 应用开发。

我是一名软件工程师，参与过汽水音乐、Talkie / 星野与微信公众号的客户端开发。从播放器、消息系统到 AI Agent，我把想法做成可用的产品。

#### 我的交付标准

比预期多走一步。让体验有品味、细节有品质，代码也清晰、可靠，经得起长期维护。

### 作品

从面向用户的客户端，到支撑交付的 AI 工程工具。四个项目，记录产品体验、系统设计与工程质量上的实践。

#### 1. [Visual Agent](/read/zh/work/visual-agent.md)

我的角色: 整体设计与开发

从产品知识到可复核的 iOS 视觉回归

面向 Doku 的视觉测试系统：把业务资料整理为可审核、可版本化的知识，再驱动 iOS 模拟器执行用例，保存判定理由、截图与录屏。

#### 2. [Talkie / 星野](/read/zh/work/talkie-xingye.md)

我的角色: iOS 高级研发工程师

IM、流式消息与网络基础设施

负责 Talkie 与星野的 IM 核心模块、消息时延优化、列表渲染，以及长连接和网络库建设。

#### 3. [汽水音乐播放器](/read/zh/work/qishui-music.md)

我的角色: iOS 研发工程师

播放器、首页组件化与播放性能优化

参与汽水音乐早期开发，负责首页播放器、歌词和 Feed 相关业务，以及缓存治理和早期版本上架。

#### 4. [微信 · 公众号](/read/zh/work/wechat-official-accounts.md)

我的角色: 客户端开发工程师

公众号推荐流的展示与点击刷新

参与微信公众号相关客户端开发，支持看一看推荐流的瀑布流展示和推荐点击刷新策略。

### Professional profile

Software engineer with five years of experience. I started in iOS, began moving into full-stack work in 2023, and have recently focused on AI applications.

Specializing in client engineering
and AI applications.

I'm a software engineer who's worked on Qishui Music, Talkie / Xingye and WeChat Official Accounts. From players and messaging systems to AI agents, I turn ideas into working products.

#### MY STANDARD

Go beyond the brief. Bring taste to the experience, care to the details, and clarity and reliability to code built to last.

### Work

From user-facing clients to AI tools that support delivery. Four projects covering product experience, system design and engineering quality.

#### 1. [Visual Agent](/read/en/work/visual-agent.md)

My role: System design & end-to-end development

From product knowledge to reviewable iOS visual regression

A visual testing system for Doku: turn product documents into reviewed, versioned knowledge, run cases on an iOS simulator, and retain verdicts, screenshots and recordings.

#### 2. [Talkie / Xingye](/read/en/work/talkie-xingye.md)

My role: Senior iOS Engineer

IM, streaming messages, and networking infrastructure

Owned core IM modules, message latency, list rendering, persistent connections, and networking infrastructure for Talkie and Xingye.

#### 3. [Qishui Music Player](/read/en/work/qishui-music.md)

My role: iOS Engineer

Player, home-screen components, and playback performance

Worked on Qishui's early client, covering the home player, lyrics, feed, caching, and initial App Store releases.

#### 4. [WeChat · Official Accounts](/read/en/work/wechat-official-accounts.md)

My role: Client Engineer

Recommendation-feed layouts and click-triggered refresh

Contribute to the Official Accounts client, including waterfall layouts and click-triggered refresh in the Top Stories feed.
